subject: Update serverpanic output based on 'extended-redis-compatibility' config. (#415)
reason: The change only edits comments and the text of two serverPanic messages (choosing 'Redis' vs 'Valkey' by the extended-redis-compatibility config). The panic paths fire only on an internal invariant violation in the built-in command table (key-spec positions inconsistent with arity), which no command sequence, config, or fault can trigger against a correctly built server. There is no reachable behaviour change to test.
